Product Features

  • 【Plenty of Storage Space】 This buffet table has a wide tabletop for kitchen utensils, coffee maker, decorations, etc. In addition, there are three open compartments, a large storage cabinet, and three drawers to organize and display your kitchen utensils.
  • 【Stable & Durable Structure】 Our kitchen buffet storage cabinet is made of high-quality chipboard with high-gloss finish (top and front panels are high-gloss), transparent acrylic door, built-in RGB LED lamp strip, sturdy and full design. The smooth, high-gloss surface is very easy to clean without worrying!
  • 【Versatile Scenes】Suitable for many occasions such as kitchens, dining rooms, hallways, entryways, etc. The coffee station cabinet can be used not only as a food preparation table, but also as an entrance cabinet for outdoor essentials, a TV shelf, or a filing cabinet in the home office.
  • 【Dimensions & Easy Assembly】Overall dimensions: 120L x 40W x 80Hcm. We have clear assembly instructions and each part comes with a corresponding number sticker, so you can easily install this kitchen cabinet.
  • 【Modern Design】The top and front panels of the coffee bar are designed in glossy white, simple and beautiful. In addition, the door of the buffet cabinet is made of acrylic, so you can probably see what is put inside. It can be used as a kitchen cabinet in the kitchen or as a coffee bar/buffet cabinet in the living room.
  • 【Storage】 The total size of the sideboard is 120L x 40W x 80Hcm. It has three drawers, a cabinet, and four open storage spaces. The large storage space gives you more space to store your dishes, items/utensils.
  • 【Easy Assembly】 After receiving the product, follow the installation instructions. (The actual time needed depends on your speed).
  • Mobile App Controlled LED Light Strips: Equipped with mobile app controlled LED light strips, you can freely adjust the lighting effects to create a warm, artistic or cool atmosphere for the living room and enhance the style of the room.

Descriptions

App application and manager:

1. iOS and Android systems can download the "LotusLantern" app by scanning the QR code. To do this, open a browser or other tool with the "Scan QR Code" feature and scan the "LotusLantern" QR code (the QR code is in the user manual). 2. Click on the LotusLantern app icon to open the app page. 3. If Bluetooth is not enabled in the app interface, you will see the message "An application wants to enable the Bluetooth feature of this device". Click "Allow". 4. Simply stick the light strip to a clean, dry surface with the self-adhesive backing. Use the included tape to improve adhesion. Please test the LED light strips before installation and install them carefully. If you have any questions, please contact us.
